legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} processes photos, generated videos, account details and payment records.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy explains how {siteName} handles information when you use this photo-to-video service. Contact support@shakingheadai.org with questions or deletion requests.
legal_privacy_collect_body: We process your account email and sign-in details, uploaded photos, generation requests, generated videos, credit balances, order references and technical logs needed to operate the service. Payment card details are handled by Stripe, not stored by this application. We may use IP addresses and essential cookies to secure accounts and limit abuse.
legal_privacy_processors_body: The service uses Cloudflare for hosting, database and file storage; Stripe for payments; and APIMart and its model providers to generate videos. Your photo must be shared with those generation processors to produce your video. We do not sell your uploaded photos. If you follow an original-source link, TikTok applies its own privacy policy.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Photos and results are stored so your jobs can run and you can retrieve them. We do not currently promise a fixed automatic deletion period. Unlisted media URLs act as shareable links: anyone who has a link may access its content, and a downloaded or cached copy cannot be recalled. Do not upload confidential or sensitive material. Account, transaction and security records may need to be retained for legal, accounting or fraud-prevention purposes. External generation providers apply their own retention policies.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: Essential cookies maintain your session, preserve attribution and protect against abuse. Your browser session storage remembers your uploaded photo path so it survives sign-in and checkout. We use Google Analytics 4 to measure page visits and interactions such as opening pricing and starting checkout. Google Analytics may use cookies and process browser, device and visit information. We do not send your photos, prompts or email address as analytics event data.
legal_privacy_choices_body: To request deletion of your uploaded photos, generated videos or account, email support@shakingheadai.org from your account email. Include the relevant job IDs or file links and tell us whether you want specific files or the whole account removed. We verify ownership before removing data under our control. Transaction, credit-ledger and security records may be retained where needed for accounting, legal or fraud-prevention purposes. We cannot recall downloaded or cached copies, and external generation providers apply their own retention policies. Do not email passwords or full payment-card details.
legal_terms_meta_description: Rules for using {siteName}, uploaded photos, AI-generated videos, credits and payments.
legal_terms_intro: By using {siteName}, you agree to these terms and the privacy and refund policies. The service provides AI-generated entertainment from animal photos you have the right to use.
legal_terms_service_body: Choose a 7.36-second or 15-second, 720p vertical head-shake video from one photo using Seedance 2.0 Mini. The short option includes the original audio excerpt at its original speed; the 15-second option loops that trend sound to fill the video. Motion, likeness and completion time can vary; exact beat synchronization or a copy of a TikTok reference is not guaranteed. TikTok references are credited third-party examples and are not outputs from this service.
legal_terms_content_body: This service is for animal photos only. Upload one animal you have the right to photograph and animate; do not upload selfies or photos of people. Do not use the service for non-consensual impersonation, harassment, sexual exploitation, fraud or infringing material. You retain your rights in your input and authorize processing needed to deliver the service. Rights in results depend on your source material and applicable provider terms. Including the reference sound does not grant additional rights to commercial songs or third-party likenesses.
legal_terms_credits_body: A 7.36-second video uses 10 credits; a 15-second video uses 20 credits. The one-time packs are $8.80 for 20 credits, $18.80 for 60 credits and $28.80 for 100 credits, in USD. You can mix both video lengths using the same balance. Purchased credits do not expire and are not a subscription. A job marked failed or canceled returns the credits spent on that job. Payment refunds are reviewed under the refund policy. Do not open multiple accounts to bypass service limits.
legal_terms_warranty_body: AI outputs are provided as generated and can contain artifacts or unexpected results. Review your video before sharing and label AI-generated media where required. We do not guarantee virality, exact resemblance, a particular platform outcome or uninterrupted availability. Any limits on liability apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law and do not remove mandatory consumer rights. Material changes to these terms will be reflected by an updated date.
legal_refunds_meta_description: Credit returns for failed jobs and how to request payment-refund review at {siteName}.
legal_refunds_intro: This policy distinguishes generation credits from money charged to your payment method. For help, contact support@shakingheadai.org with your account email, order reference and job ID.
legal_refunds_failed_body: When a job is marked failed or canceled, its spent credits are returned automatically. This restores generation credits; it does not automatically refund a card payment. If a job stays queued or generating for more than 35 minutes, reopen your account to refresh its status. If it remains unresolved, contact support@shakingheadai.org with the job ID instead of starting another job for the same request.
legal_refunds_unused_body: Contact support within seven days of purchasing a pack to request a review of unused credits, duplicate charges or an incorrect charge. Do not spend credits associated with a refund request while it is being reviewed. A completed video normally consumes its credits. If it cannot be played or downloaded, is missing its main subject, or has another material technical problem, send the job ID and a description so we can review an appropriate resolution. Differences in AI expressions, movement or exact timing do not by themselves trigger an automatic credit or card refund. Applicable statutory consumer rights remain in effect.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Email support@shakingheadai.org from your account email. Include the order reference, relevant job ID and a short explanation; never include full card details. We review requests and explain the outcome. Approved payment refunds go back to the original payment method and can take additional processing time.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to report copyright infringement or request a takedown on {siteName}.
legal_dmca_intro: If you believe content accessible through {siteName} infringes your rights, contact support@shakingheadai.org. The TikTok references are credited and linked to their original creators, rather than presented as our own work.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Provide your name and contact details, identify the work you own, give the exact URLs or job IDs at issue, explain the claimed infringement and include a good-faith statement that the use is not authorized. Include a statement that the notice is accurate and that you are the owner or authorized representative, together with your signature. We review sufficiently specific complaints and may restrict access while investigating.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If you believe your content was removed by mistake, reply to the takedown communication with the affected URLs, your contact information and an explanation of your rights or authorization. We may request the information needed for an applicable formal counter-notice process. Do not send unnecessary sensitive documents.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: We may suspend or close accounts that repeatedly infringe intellectual-property rights or misuse the service. We can remove reported references or outputs when appropriate.
